adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6` the `save()` action sends `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')`, which can be `null`/blank (new host starts with `categoryId: null`, and `cantSave` only checks host string). On the server, `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` explicitly substitutes `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` when `host.category_id.blank?`. However, after the save resolves, the client unconditionally does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))`; if `categoryId` was blank, this sets `category` to `undefined` even though the server stored/returned an uncategorized `category_id`, causing the UI (`{{category-badge host.category}}`) to be out of sync until reload.
